description.zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh:
是否过滤开启了DAS企业版的数据库实例：
- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。

> 取值为**true**时，只统计未开启DAS企业版的数据库实例；取值为**false**时，统计所有数据库实例。
description.en:
Specifies whether to filter instances for which DAS Enterprise Edition is enabled. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

> If you set this parameter to **true**, only database instances for which DAS Enterprise Edition is disabled are queried. If you set this parameter to **false**, all database instances are queried.

description.zh:
数据库实例ID。

> 仅支持RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL版数据库实例。
description.en:
The database instance ID.

> The database instance must be an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance or a PolarDB for MySQL cluster.

description.zh:
节点ID。

> 对于RDS MySQL集群系列数据库实例或PolarDB MySQL版数据库实例，需要提供节点ID。
description.en:
The node ID.

> For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL Cluster Edition instances or PolarDB for MySQL clusters, you must specify the node ID.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh:
自动SQL优化事件的持续时间阈值。
设置此参数后，只会统计持续时间不超过阈值的自动SQL优化事件。

> 此参数为备用参数，当前暂不生效。
description.en:
The duration threshold for automatic SQL optimization events. After this parameter is specified, the system collects statistics on automatic SQL optimization events whose duration does not exceed the specified threshold.

> This parameter is a reserved parameter and does not take effect.

description.zh:
是否合并事件：
- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。

> 此参数为备用参数，当前暂不生效。
description.en:
Specifies whether to merge automatic SQL optimization events. Valid values:

- **true**: merges automatic SQL optimization events.

- **false**: does not merge automatic SQL optimization events.

> This parameter is a reserved parameter and does not take effect.

title.zh: 获取自动SQL优化事件的统计数据

descriptions.zh:
使用该接口需满足以下前提条件：

- 使用阿里云或DAS的SDK时，建议使用最新版本。
- 使用SDK调用DAS服务时，需要将地域指定为cn-shanghai。
- 数据库引擎为RDS MySQL或PolarDB MySQL版。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, take note of the following items:

- If you use an Alibaba Cloud SDK or a Database Autonomy Service (DAS) SDK to call this API operation, we recommend that you use the latest version of the SDK.

- If you use an SDK to call API operations of DAS, you must set the region ID to cn-shanghai.

- The database engine is ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or PolarDB for MySQL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun das get-instance-sql-optimize-statistic --instance-id pc-wz90h9560rvdz0000 --start-time 1661308902060 --end-time 1662518540764 --node-id pi-bp12v7243x0120000 --threshold None --filter-enable false --use-merging true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun das GetInstanceSqlOptimizeStatistic --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1662518540764 --InstanceId 'pc-wz90h9560rvdz0000' --StartTime 1661308902060 --NodeId 'pi-bp12v7243x0120000' --UseMerging true --FilterEnable false --Threshold None
